images.alt: A photo of the south island with the title Metservice Severe weather watches and warnings. Parts of the island are coloured in orange and yellow, with yellow for southern fiordland and a yellow rain icon, then orange colouring with orange rain icons for the ranges of westland down to northern fiordland, and orange colouring with an orange wind icon over part of the canterbury high country.

post.text:
🌧️ New Severe Weather Watches and Warnings Issued 🍃

🌧️ Orange Heavy Rain Warnings have been issued for the Westland Ranges, and the Canterbury and Otago Headwaters

🍃 Orange Strong Wind Warning has been issued for the Canterbury High Country, with gusts up to 130 km/h forecast.

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
